end.summary: Explored levels of organisation in humans and plants.
end.parentNote: Yash practised defining an organ system and identifying examples of organs working together. They explained that the heart is one organ, while the circulatory system includes the heart, blood vessels and blood; this mix-up was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). They also gave the correct order up to organism with support, but the full sequence was not yet secure. At home, ask Yash to arrange and explain “cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism” using one human example and one plant example.
